name: European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) beyond 2027
organization: European Commission, LIBER, EUA and partners
description: Governance and funding of the European Open Science Cloud after the current framework period: whether EOSC continues as a distinct, Work Programme-based European Partnership under FP10, how the Federation of nodes operates, and which institutions are recognised as supporting infrastructure.

milestones.label: First 13 EOSC Nodes begin operating; 27 more joining in two waves
LIBER position: libraries as EOSC supporting infrastructure, distinct partnership under FP10
EUA position: EOSC remains a distinct, research-focused partnership with its own work programme
